resolution.question: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the petition has collected at least 1,500 valid signatures before 2026-09-14T17:00:00-06:00 (the deadline). Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
